entities.summary: Jeffrey Joseph Giuliano is an American former ice hockey left winger who played 101 games in the National Hockey League for the Los Angeles Kings during the 2005–06 and 2007–08 seasons. The rest of his career, which lasted from 2002 to 2015, was spent in the minor leagues and then in the Deutsche Eishockey Liga.
